billingSettings.title: Rental billing settings
billingSettings.subtitle: Configure how MONTHLY-priced rentals are billed for this tenant
billingSettings.customMonthLengthDays: Number of days in one custom billing month

CALENDAR_MONTH.label: Calendar month
CALENDAR_MONTH.description: Bills from a date to the corresponding date in the next calendar month, with end-of-month handling.

FIXED_30_DAYS.label: Fixed 30 days
FIXED_30_DAYS.description: Every 30 billable days is treated as one monthly billing unit.

CUSTOM.label: Custom period
CUSTOM.description: Define how many billable days make up one monthly billing unit.

PRORATE_BY_DAY.label: Charge proportionally by day
PRORATE_BY_DAY.description: Full months are billed at the monthly price; any remaining days are billed at the daily rate.

ROUND_UP_TO_FULL_MONTH.label: Charge started month as full month
ROUND_UP_TO_FULL_MONTH.description: Any started additional month is billed as one complete month — no separate daily rate is needed.
